decision.rationale: TXN-008031 is a charge of 105.76 EUR (10576 minor units) on card CRD-000046 at QUAYSIDE CLOTHING (MER-000042). It was posted on 2026-08-22. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 64 days later, so it falls within the 120-day time limit. The authorisation behind it, AUTH-008228, shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure AUTHENTICATED, CVV MATCH and no fraud flag. Under the policy, an online payment the cardholder confirmed with 3-D Secure, with no fraud flag, counts as made by the cardholder, and the matching CVV supports this. The cardholder says the card stayed with them the whole time, but that does not change the outcome: the card did not need to be present for an online payment, and the payment was confirmed through 3-D Secure. The rule for card-not-present payments without strong authentication does not apply. The dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show that this online payment was confirmed through 3-D Secure, the bank's online payment check, and the card security code was entered correctly. Under our policy, a payment confirmed this way counts as made by the cardholder, so we are declining this dispute.
